artifact_schema.description: A nontrivial exact divisor of the historical RSA-2048 challenge modulus.

factor.description: A positive canonical decimal factor f such that 1 < f < N and N mod f = 0.

statement: Find a nontrivial divisor of the fixed 2048-bit RSA Factoring Challenge number RSA-2048. Submit {"factor": "..."} as a canonical decimal string. The pinned checker verifies exact divisibility and a nontrivial complementary factor; it does not assert primality of either side. This is a historical academic challenge: RSA Laboratories ended its original prize contest in 2007, and this objective has only Cairn's notional Stage 0 reward. The modulus is transcribed from RSA Inc's published RSA-2048 challenge, hosted by MysteryTwister: https://mysterytwister.org/media/challenges/pdf/mtc3-rsa-38-en.pdf. No claim is made here that factoring RSA-2048 alone breaks current RSA deployments.
